first_1.text: Oh, you're the Warden's stranger! I'm Tobbin, I build things.

first_2.text: Mostly things that fly. Well, things that try to fly.

machine.text: A flying machine! It needs a lens, a spring and a valve, and I'm out of all three.

help.text: Lens at the empty market stall, spring on my bench, valve by the old pipes. Drop them in my basket!

parts_1.text: Lens at the market stall, spring on my bench, valve by the old pipes.

parts_2.text: Drop them in the basket, not on me. I learned that the hard way.

gift_1.text: All three! You're better at this than me, and I'm the expert!

gift_2.text: Here, take my Pulse Lantern. It wakes up old ship machines, mostly.

gift_3.text: Take it to the shrine on the bridge. The Warden will know what to do!

chat_1.text: How's the Lantern? It hasn't exploded, has it?

choices.text: Why do you want to fly?

chat_great.text: Of course it does, I built it. With a lot of help.

chat_fly.text: Because the islands are up there, and everyone says nobody can go. That sounds like a challenge.
